message: Hi, my little one Leo is 6 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! Leo would be a great fit for our Little Tigers BJJ program, which is designed specifically for kids ages 5 to 7. No experience needed at all. Is this something you'd like to get him started with?
Yes, I’d love to get him started! What are the available time slots?

Little Tigers classes for Leo's age group run Monday through Thursday at 4:00pm to 4:45pm, and Saturday mornings at 9:00am to 9:45am. Would any of those times work for you to bring him in for a free trial?
The Monday at 4:00pm slot works for us. Let’s sign him up for the free trial!
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! What's the best email to send the trial confirmation to?
You can send it to tester.sierra@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Leo's full name and date of birth to complete the registration.
His full name is Leo Sierra, and he was born on May 9, 2020.
Perfect! I have Leo's info. I can get him booked for Monday, July 13th at 4:00pm, Monday, July 20th at 4:00pm, or Monday, July 27th at 4:00pm. Which Monday works best for you?
I’d like to book him for Monday, July 13th at 4:00pm. Thank you!

All set! Leo is booked for his free Little Tigers BJJ trial on Monday, July 13th at 4:00pm. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.sierra@gmail.com. Just bring him in comfortable clothes and we'll take great care of him. See you then!
